pooling: mean of final backbone feature map H,W, before classifier

preprocess.crop: none; whole-frame anisotropic resize to preserve all edge content

limitation: ImageNet classification backbone, not DINOv2. Whole-frame warp differs from official center-crop evaluation. Similarity is candidate evidence, not proof of event identity or leakage.
retrieval: exact cross-split normalized inner product in bounded NumPy batches; no within-train all-pairs
